Local optional printed-text OCR assets. No CDN fallback is configured.

Pinned sources:
Tesseract.js 6.0.1: https://registry.npmjs.org/tesseract.js/-/tesseract.js-6.0.1.tgz
Tesseract.js-core 6.0.0: https://registry.npmjs.org/tesseract.js-core/-/tesseract.js-core-6.0.0.tgz
English: https://registry.npmjs.org/@tesseract.js-data/eng/-/eng-1.0.0.tgz
Hindi: https://registry.npmjs.org/@tesseract.js-data/hin/-/hin-1.0.0.tgz
Models are the 4.0.0_best_int/*.traineddata.gz entries from these pinned packages.

Licenses:
Tesseract.js and its core are Apache-2.0; upstream licenses and minifier notices are included.
Upstream Tesseract trained data is Apache-2.0 (LICENSE-MODELS):
https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_best/blob/main/LICENSE
The npm language package manifests declare MIT for their packaging; no package JavaScript is bundled.
PACKAGE-METADATA.json preserves package names, versions, licenses, source revisions and npm integrity.

Core wasm.js files embed WASM. OEM=1/LSTM-only is fixed in the application.
SIMD and non-SIMD LSTM builds are supplied; legacy OCR is not enabled.

SHA-256 of bundled engine/model files:

Delivery packaging: large upstream core/model files are stored in parts/*.bin (max512KiB). StudioOCR assembles byte-identical logical files in the optional browser cache. Original and part SHA-256 values are in PACKAGE-METADATA.json. No upstream executable/model bytes were changed.
